name: agentsys
description: 11 specialized plugins for AI workflow automation - GitHub issue queue for native agents, slop detection, negative behavior memory, skill and system prompt curation, topic research, agent config linting, workflow pattern learning, Zig language support, Mojo language support, and Ada/SPARK language support

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: GitHub issues as a task queue for native agents: pick, claim, worktree workers, Revuto findings, land through the repo's own land command

plugins.name: deslop
plugins.description: 3-phase AI slop detection: regex patterns (HIGH), multi-pass analyzers (MEDIUM), CLI tools (LOW)

plugins.name: skill-curator
plugins.description: Canonical guidance for writing, reviewing, and maintaining production-grade SKILL.md files across agent tools

plugins.name: system-prompt-curator
plugins.description: Production-grade system prompt curation for autonomous coding agents and multi-agent orchestration

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Research topics online and create comprehensive learning guides with RAG-optimized indexes

plugins.name: banthis
plugins.description: Durable negative behavior memory: persist user-defined banned agent behaviors into CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md

plugins.name: agnix
plugins.description: Lint agent configuration files (SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, hooks, MCP) against 457 rules across 10+ AI tools

plugins.name: skillers
plugins.description: Learn from workflow patterns across sessions and suggest skills, hooks, and agents to automate repetitive work

plugins.name: zig-lsp
plugins.description: Zig language server for Claude Code via ZLS - automatic diagnostics after every edit, jump-to-definition, find-references, and hover. Requires zls in PATH

plugins.name: mojo
plugins.description: Teach agents to write idiomatic, correct, performant, current Mojo (v1.0.0b1) - syntax, ownership and CPU/memory optimization (copies, SIMD, vectorize/parallelize), GPU kernels (DeviceContext/LayoutTensor), and Mojo/Python interop; prevents stale pre-2025 syntax

plugins.name: ada-spark
plugins.description: Teach agents to write idiomatic, correct, current Ada and SPARK (Ada 2022) - contracts (aspects, Pre'Class), the Alire ecosystem, SPARK proof (AoRTE, assurance levels, ownership/borrow), embedded (Ravenscar/Jorvik), and GNAT/GNAT SAS tooling; blocks stale pre-2022 advice (GNAT Community, pragma contracts, CodePeer)
